display_name: Ondo Tokenized Securities Heat & Movers Scanner
summary: Daily Ondo tokenized-equity scan in two lanes: (1) market status (open/closed/pre/post) for the universe, (2) discovery — merge alpha hotrank candidates with 24h price movers, dedupe, and surface top-N by composite score.
core_logic: Accept ondo universe + market status + alpha-hotrank + 24h-mover snapshot via inputs.
Build hotrank candidates list (alpha-rank top tokens that intersect ondo tickers).
Build mover candidates list (top abs(24h_change_pct) movers).
Merge both lists, dedupe by ticker, score = hotrank-rank-points + mover-rank-points + cross-source bonus.
Return top-N with metadata (ticker, symbol, chain, 24h change, hotrank position, premium).
recommended_next_step: Cross-reference with earnings-tradfi-scanner output for an event-driven view.
